rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an opportunity or an attainable possibility.

example.english: I finally got a chance to travel to Japan.
example.traditional: 我終於有機會去日本旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jau5 gei1 wui6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this instead of 機會 when chance means an abstract likelihood or possibility rather than an opportunity.

example.english: The chance of this team advancing isn't high.
example.traditional: 呢隊波出線嘅可能性唔高。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 bo1 ceot1 sin3 ge3 ho2 nang4 sing3 m4 gou1

rows.note: Use this for chance as luck or an outcome that depends on luck.

example.english: Whether we win this time depends on chance.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 jeng4 m4 jeng4 jiu3 kaau3 wan6 hei3
